center_contract.rounding: All four coordinates int(width_or_height * fraction), PIL crop end exclusive.

postprocessing: Byte-for-byte copies only. PIL used to inspect dimensions and alpha; no resizing, cropping, cleanup or pixel modifications.
limits: These layers match the existing project's interpreted backgrounds and are not extracted original Sega art or certified 1:1 source reproductions.
The center permits alpha values 0 or 1 under the requested contract; no pixel in the tested rectangle may exceed 1.
Native landscape dimensions are retained; runtime scales layers into the established arena rectangle.
Relative depth, final compositing and motion must be checked in the game's renderer; integration belongs to the parent task.
No runtime code, shared catalogue, import metadata, commit or remote push is changed by this batch.
